brief:
Israeli filmmakers Rachel Szor and Yuval Abraham documented testimony from 24 intelligence insiders who participated in remotely targeting homes in Gaza, The Guardian reported. The directors collected accounts from personnel who described themselves as "small cogs" in the targeting system. The film explores how intelligence operatives identified and selected civilian locations for strikes.

The project centered on extracting detailed accounts from former and current military intelligence workers willing to discuss their roles in the process. Szor and Abraham conducted interviews on a darkened rooftop in Tel Aviv as part of their reporting. The documentary presents firsthand descriptions of the targeting methodology used by Israeli forces during operations in Gaza.
